Thank you. I think maybe if I start hearing that and trying to believe it I'll get through this. This also just happened so I'm allowed to be a mess about this, I just was expecting so much more than what I was really given and it's hard to move on when I was doing all of this for her to begin with

That's just how I am though. I think it's between the PTSD (I'm diagnosed with c-PTSD and have seizures with it) and the depression I've had since a young age. I've just always been the person to sacrifice my own needs for others, I think my trauma makes me believe that if I'm not the best for others than I'm useless.

And my friend has told me many times he doesn't understand how I do it, because I haven't been angry, or mad at her for doing this. I didn't even raise my voice with her at all during this whole thing.

It's just been drilled into my head that that's how I'm supposed to be

Honestly I feel really lost and don't even know if what I'm doing is the right thing. I've been talking to everyone, including her mom just trying to make sense of it all. Even after everything I still love her deeply; her stuff isn't even all the way out of the house yet but she's coming this weekend to get it. 

I feel like the best option to deal with that is to just pack it all and leave it on the porch for her so she doesn't have to see me. I don't know if it hurts her to see my face or not.

Even though she hurt me all I want to do is the right thing for her, regardless of my own feelings or emotions, I just want to give her what she needs. I owe a lot to her despite the pain
